ITEM 1 | Small brown oval nuts with smooth tan-brown skins, pointed ends, dry matte surface, scattered in a dense layer covering roughly 35% of the plate on the left side, several nuts stacked in places | 60
ITEM 2 | Whole red-and-yellow glossy apple, about 8 cm diameter, smooth waxy skin with a small stem dimple on top, sitting at the upper right edge of the plate | 180
ITEM 3 | Orange raw carrot pieces, cut into wedges and sticks about 3-5 cm long and 1-2 cm thick, firm with slightly matte surface, grouped in a cluster of roughly 10% of the plate near the apple | 75
ITEM 4 | Cauliflower florets, creamy white with slightly textured, bumpy surfaces, individual florets about 2-4 cm across on thin pale green-white stems, arranged in a loose cluster across the lower right of the plate, covering roughly 20% of the plate, dry and firm with no visible sauce or browning | 110
